verdict.rationale: Firebase has an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets, interacts with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. Its official MCP server lets an agent create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data. Security Rules are the documented policy layer, but nothing in the evidence shows rules, auth configuration, or schema being provisioned headlessly from a script; 'deploy code and assets' is only implied to cover them. Missing for 10: explicit CLI deployment of Security Rules/indexes, CLI configuration of auth providers (beyond user import/export), any schema-provisioning workflow, documented non-interactive/CI scripting mode, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent-driven setup.
